verdict.rationale: The collection ships an official skill-creator meta-skill, documented as 'a skill for creating new skills and iteratively improving them'. It also benchmarks skill performance and optimizes descriptions for triggering, and a runtime probe confirmed it installs cleanly as a standalone skill. The evidence never shows skill-creator guiding the agent through packaging or distributing a finished skill; packaging appears only in separate plugin/marketplace docs, not as part of the meta-skill. missing for 10: documented packaging/bundling step inside skill-creator, independent hands-on corroboration of the authoring and improvement workflow quality.

support.subject: As a developer, the collection ships a meta-skill or tool that guides my agent through writing, improving, and packaging new skills

citations.quote: A skill for creating new skills and iteratively improving them.
Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance.
benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy
